title: Set active identity synchronously before filtering events
trigger: Event relay/filter reads a mutable active identity (active tab, focused window, selected item) that can change between the trigger and the filter check
principle: When an event is relayed/filtered based on a mutable identity, that identity must be updated synchronously with the trigger that changes the active scope. If the update is async, events from the new scope arrive before the filter identity updates → they get filtered against the stale old scope and dropped. Set the identity synchronously first, then async-verify/revert if the new scope turns out to be invalid.

cases.context: Sidepanel relay filters subtitle-cue messages by activeTabIdForPanel; tab activation updates identity inside an async getTab() promise, so cues from the newly-activated tab are dropped against the old tab id
Defense-in-depth: even with sync identity, a live message can still be dropped if the relay handler races; re-sync from cache when the active tab finishes loading
cases.bad: // sidepanel only listens to live relay messages — if one is dropped, panel stays stale until close/reopen

applyFor: Chrome extension active tab / window focus tracking (sidepanel relay, popup state, badge)
Event bus filtering by currentUser, selectedItem, activeRoom
WebSocket/WebRTC message routing based on active session
Any filter/render that reads activeX state right after the active scope changed
